description: The connected LINE Official Account’s monthly message quota: the limit on its plan (or that it has none) and how many messages have been used this month, as LINE reports them. WHAT COUNTS: push, multicast, broadcast and narrowcast messages, one per person reached; a reply sent inside a minute of a person’s message does not. Read it before send_line_broadcast. LINE calls the usage figure approximate, and it includes messages sent from LINE’s own Official Account Manager. A number LINE did not return is reported as unknown, never as zero. LINE bills the quota to the account on its own plan; Hermoso charges nothing. Free, 0 credits.
name: line_quota
title: Read the LINE message quota
